definitions.gloss: being attached to, adjoining, having an annexed facility
definitions.explanation: Setting up or having an additional facility alongside or within an existing one. Describes the relationship where a secondary facility operates together with a main one.

examples.japanese: ホテルに{併設|へいせつ}されたレストラン。
examples.english: A restaurant attached to the hotel.

examples.japanese: {図書館|としょかん}にカフェが{併設|へいせつ}されている。
examples.english: A cafe is attached to the library.

examples.japanese: この{病院|びょういん}には{研究|けんきゅう}{施設|しせつ}が{併設|へいせつ}されており、{最新|さいしん}の{治療|ちりょう}を{受|う}けられる。
examples.english: This hospital has an attached research facility, allowing patients to receive the latest treatments.

notes:
Commonly used in descriptions of buildings, institutions, and commercial facilities. The pattern is typically: [main facility]に[secondary facility]が{併設|へいせつ}されている.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～に{併設|へいせつ}されている (attached to ~)
- {併設|へいせつ}の～ (the attached ~)
- {併設|へいせつ}{施設|しせつ} (attached facility)
- カフェ{併設|へいせつ} (with an attached cafe)

USAGE:
Most often used in the passive form ({併設|へいせつ}されている) to describe the existing arrangement. The active form ({併設|へいせつ}する) is used when describing the act of establishing the secondary facility.
